data.title: ‘This one stings’: Clarity Act fails procedural Senate vote — is crypto’s biggest regulatory push dead?
data.summary_raw: A procedural vote to advance landmark digital asset legislation failed spectacularly on Tuesday, leaving the crypto industry crushed.

data.title: Clarity Act preliminary vote falls short in Senate amid ethics fight over Trump’s crypto wealth

data.title: Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she wants a crypto bill, but the Clarity Act just isn’t it
